::api-operation{method="GET" path="/v1/businesses/{biz}/emails/report"}
#docs
Billing email counts by week and by email type for the last `weeks` weeks, this week included. Weeks run Monday to Sunday in the business time zone, and an email counts in the week it was queued. `delivered` and `not_delivered` follow the same rules as `/emails/activity`. A complaint counts in `complained` only, not in `bounced`. There is no open or click tracking.

## Path parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `biz` | `string` | **yes** | Business id (biz_…) |

## Query parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `weeks` | `integer` | no | How many weeks to count, this week included. |

## Response

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `object` | `string` | The object type; always `email_delivery_report`. One of `email_delivery_report`. |
| `weeks` | `integer` | How many weeks the report covers. |
| `timezone` | `string` | The business time zone the weeks are counted in. |
| `from` | `string` | The first day of the first week (YYYY-MM-DD). |
| `weekly` | `array of object` | One row for each week, the oldest first. |
| `by_type` | `array of object` | One row for each email type with email in the period. |
| `totals` | `object` | The counts for the whole period. |

## Status codes

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `200` | Success |
| `400` | weeks is not a whole number from 1 to 52 |
| `404` | No such business |

#request
```bash [Request]
curl "$TMBILLING_URL/v1/businesses/biz_XXXXXXXXXXXX01/emails/report" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TMBILLING_API_KEY"
```
